C0088.title: Can a no-threshold referral-rebate plugin constitute pyramid scheme crime?
C0088.summary: A legal seminar case examines a quantitative trading assistant plugin offered free of charge. Users who refer others can receive a share of the 30% profit the plugin platform earns, with rebate layers extending up to five levels.
